research_mode: official Building Safety Regulator, Home Office and GOV.UK primary guidance only; enforcement and Fire Safety (England) Regulations methodology gates; no parcel result or safety score claimed

sources.name: External-wall information to FRS
verified_claims: Responsible persons for existing high-rise residential buildings must provide the local fire and rescue service with information on external-wall design and materials.
limitations: A submitted description does not independently verify the actual wall system.

sources.name: External-wall material-change notice
verified_claims: Material changes to a high-rise building's external walls must be notified to the local fire and rescue service.
limitations: A notification duty does not establish whether a change is material or has occurred.

sources.name: External-wall risk and mitigation record
verified_claims: The responsible person must provide information on external-fire-spread risk and mitigating steps.
limitations: A stated mitigation does not prove implementation or effectiveness.

sources.name: Partial external-wall information
verified_claims: Where complete wall information is unavailable, responsible persons should provide what they hold, update the fire-risk assessment and send updated information as soon as possible.
limitations: Providing partial information does not satisfy missing evidence or prove the assessment is complete.

sources.name: Electronic floor plans for each floor
verified_claims: High-rise responsible persons must prepare and electronically share up-to-date floor plans showing key firefighting equipment for each floor.
limitations: Plan submission does not prove accuracy or current site configuration.

sources.name: Identical-floor plan reuse
verified_claims: Where floors are identical, one floor plan may represent those identical floors.
limitations: Visual similarity alone is insufficient to establish that floors are identical.

sources.name: Single-page building plan
verified_claims: A single-page building plan should show key firefighting equipment and provide an overview of the building, access points and environs.
limitations: A simplified plan does not replace detailed floor plans or operational verification.

sources.name: Hard-copy plans in secure box
verified_claims: Hard copies of floor plans and the building plan should be kept in the secure information box on the premises.
limitations: Presence in a box does not prove plans are current, legible or accessible during an incident.

sources.name: Monthly firefighter-lift checks
verified_claims: High-rise responsible persons must carry out monthly checks of firefighter lifts, evacuation lifts and relevant control mechanisms.
limitations: A monthly check record does not prove the lift will operate in an emergency.

sources.name: Monthly essential-equipment checks
verified_claims: Essential firefighting equipment listed by the regulations requires monthly checking and necessary steps to remedy faults.
limitations: A visual or functional check does not replace planned specialist maintenance.

sources.name: Twenty-four-hour fault reporting
verified_claims: A relevant lift or equipment fault that cannot be resolved within 24 hours must be reported electronically to the fire and rescue service as soon as practicable, with resolution later reported.
limitations: The reporting rule does not establish whether a particular defect met the threshold or deadline.

sources.name: Resident-accessible check records
verified_claims: Monthly check outcomes must be recorded openly and made accessible to residents.
limitations: Public availability does not prove completeness, accuracy or timely remediation.

sources.name: High-rise floor and flat signage
verified_claims: Existing high-rise residential buildings must have clear wayfinding markings identifying floors and individual flats.
limitations: A signage requirement does not establish that installed signs meet visibility and location specifications.

sources.name: Low-light and smoke visibility
verified_claims: Wayfinding signage is intended to be visible in normal, low-light and smoky conditions to support firefighter navigation.
limitations: Intended visibility must not be assumed without inspection under relevant conditions.

sources.name: Secure information box content and access
verified_claims: A high-rise building's secure information box should hold responsible-person contact details and hard-copy plans and be accessible to the fire and rescue service.
limitations: A box's presence does not prove security, completeness, current contents or operational access.
